Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥8,677 million. Its main locations are the store TOBICHI in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, which also serves as its head office; TOBICHI Kyoto in Kyoto, Kyoto Prefecture; the event space Hobonichi Nichiyobi in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; and the studio of Hobonichi no Gakkō in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.
